title: Quota backend: reserve, settle, release and operator grant
description: Milestone M2 of the Auritus and Babulus merge. Unit: integer US cents of cloud cost per account (owner's recommended default, pending confirmation). One allowance per account, shared by every app. SigV4 routes POST /v1/quota/accounts/{id}/reservations, .../reservations/{reservationId}/settle and .../release, authorized by a registered product's role with the quota flag; client operation IDs make retries safe. Fails closed. Stored as Kanbus/Virtuus files in a separate quota project with a journal. Operator grant route under accounts:admin:quota. Adds a /server quota client and replaces the placeholder portal and CRM quota screens. Stripe and billing out of scope; no product registered here.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on branch feature/quota-backend (PR to develop to follow): quota/ module (service, handler, tests), Rust bridge quota project, accounts-client /server serverQuotaClient, operator grant route (accounts:admin:quota), CRM and portal quota screens, docs/QUOTA.md, features/quota-*.feature. Needs owner decisions listed in docs/QUOTA.md: unit (integer US cents applied), maximum hold lifetime (24h default), no monthly reset yet, who holds accounts:admin:quota. New persistent IAM (central runtime S3 prefixes for quota) and the held directory BFF operator-write policy need approval; nothing deployed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-11-02 model change from the owner: weekly percent quota instead of cents. Products report billable items; a private rate table in an SSM SecureString (outside Git) converts them to internal units; customers see percent used and the reset time only. Two paths: reserve/settle/release and check/record. Week = fixed 7 days from Account creation, UTC. Reworked on feature/quota-backend (PR 110). Reconciliation against real bills filed as a follow-up.
